gloss: one song; one piece of music

definitions.explanation: {一|いち} plus the counter {曲|きょく} (pieces of music). Used for a single song or instrumental piece in a performance, on a program, or on a recording.

examples.japanese: もう{一曲|いっきょく}{歌|うた}ってください。
アンコールで{一曲|いっきょく}だけ{演奏|えんそう}した。
examples.english: They played just one song for the encore.

examples.japanese: この{一曲|いっきょく}を{仕上|しあ}げるのに、{半年|はんとし}{以上|いじょう}かかったそうだ。
examples.english: I hear it took them more than six months to finish this one song.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- もう{一曲|いっきょく}: one more song
- {一曲|いっきょく}{歌|うた}う: to sing a song
- {一曲|いっきょく}{目|め}: the first song (on a program or setlist)
- {一曲|いっきょく}{丸|まる}ごと: a whole song, all the way through

COUNTING PATTERN:
The counter {曲|きょく} continues {二曲|にきょく}, {三曲|さんきょく}, {四曲|よんきょく}, {五曲|ごきょく}, {何曲|なんきょく} (how many songs). Note the sound change in {一曲|いっきょく} and {六曲|ろっきょく}.
